opportunities.point: RedTape Limited targets continued strong revenue growth in FY27 through accelerated retail expansion, category diversification, and channel growth.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "RedTape Limited targets continued strong revenue growth in FY27, supported by accelerated retail expansion, with a particular focus on South and West India, along with category diversification, e-commerce and quick commerce channel growth, women’s and kids’..." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company intends to open 200-250 new stores annually with store sizes ranging from 500 sq. ft. to 1,500 sq. ft.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The Company intends to open 200-250 new stores annually with store size of 500sq. ft. – 1500 sq. ft., deepen its presence in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, scale the Ozark performance wear brand, and extend its lifestyle portfolio into new product categories..." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to add almost 200 to 250 stores with sizes ranging between 500 and 1,500 square feet.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We are planning to add almost 200 to 250 stores. Having said that, the square feet of the store would be around 500 to 1,500 square feet." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: One new marketplace warehouse was operationalised in FY26 alongside 3,00,000 sq. ft. added in the existing Unnao warehouse.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "• Marketplace Warehouse: One new warehouse operationalised in FY26; 3,00,000 sq.ft. added in existing warehouse of Unnao, Kanpur." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Commissioned capacity should start contributing to revenue.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 25 Cr -> 4 Cr (-84%) as of Sep 2026

opportunities.point: The underlying demand for branded footwear and lifestyle apparel in India remains very much intact.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "While the first half had its moments of softness, the second half and particularly Q3, carrying into Q4, showed us clearly that the underlying demand for branded footwear and lifestyle apparel in India is very much intact." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Consumers in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns are making a clear and steady shift toward organized branded products.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The Indian consumer, especially in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns where the majority of our stores sit, is making a clear and steady shift towards organized branded product." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Same-store sales growth (SSSG) was 17.8% in Q4.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our SSSG, which is the same-store sales growth was 17.8% in Q4." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company ended the year with 223 exclusive showrooms across 161 cities.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "On our network, we ended the year with 223 exclusive showrooms across 161 cities." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to reduce inventory days to a target range of 120 days to 150 days.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Anywhere between 120 days to 150 days." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to scale the Ozark retail footprint due to strong response in the performance outdoor category.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "The consumer appetite for a credible Indian brand in the performance outdoor category is larger than we initially estimated, and we are scaling the Ozark retail footprint accordingly." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
